Select assay_chembl_id, tid, assay_description, target_name, target_organism, journal, year, volume, first_page, and doi. Source assays and target_dictionary. Join target_dictionary on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid. Join docs on assays.doc_id = docs.doc_id. Filter where assay_type is 'B' and tid is 165. Sort by assay_chembl_id, tid, journal, year, and doi.
